# 1. The throne's tradition is established (tracks 1-3)
oe_cel.1 = {

	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
		add_prestige = 5
	}
}

# 2. Yuan: a touxia prince asks to be raised (fired by W3 oe_cel_ci_touxia_bridge)
oe_cel.2 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel.2.title
	desc = oe_cel.2.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel_princes_enfeoffed.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.2.a
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_touxia_target }
			var:oe_cel_touxia_target ?= {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_great_ulus_mod mode = replace }
				add_liberty_desire = -10
			}
			remove_variable = oe_cel_touxia_target
		}
		add_prestige = -5
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.2.b
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_touxia_target }
			var:oe_cel_touxia_target ?= {
				add_liberty_desire = 5
			}
			remove_variable = oe_cel_touxia_target
		}
	}
}

# 6. Revocation crisis, named by track (fired by W3 oe_cel_ci_revoke_fanwang)
oe_cel.6 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel.6.title
	desc = oe_cel.6.desc
	outcome = negative
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel_fanwang_revolt.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.6.a
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_rebel_fief }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_crisis_active value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_crisis_due years = 10 }
			var:oe_cel_rebel_fief ?= {
				add_liberty_desire = 50
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_cel_rebel_fief ?= {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
						NOT = { this = root }
						NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
						NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }
					}
					NOT = { has_casus_belli_on = var:oe_cel_rebel_fief }
				}
				add_casus_belli = {
					target = var:oe_cel_rebel_fief
					type = casus_belli:oe_cel_cb_punish_rebel_fief
					years = 10
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.6.b
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_rebel_fief }
			var:oe_cel_rebel_fief ?= {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_guards_stripped_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
				add_liberty_desire = 15
			}
			remove_variable = oe_cel_rebel_fief
		}
		add_prestige = -5
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.6.c
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_rebel_fief }
			var:oe_cel_rebel_fief ?= {
				add_liberty_desire = -20
			}
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_cel.8 days = 30 }
	}
}

# 7. Crisis won (yearly pulse)
oe_cel.7 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel.7.title
	desc = oe_cel.7.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel_fanwang_revolt.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		remove_variable = oe_cel_crisis_active
		remove_variable = oe_cel_crisis_due
		remove_variable = oe_cel_rebel_fief
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.7.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
		add_prestige = 20
		change_celestial_authority = { value = celestial_authority_weak_bonus }
		oe_cel_cool_revocation_tension = { amount = 3 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_fiefs_subdued_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
}

# 9. A princely fief's ruler died (on_ruler_death_delayed)
oe_cel.9 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel.9.title
	desc = oe_cel.9.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel_princes_enfeoffed.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.9.a
		ai_chance = { base = 70 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_dead_fief }
			var:oe_cel_dead_fief ?= {
				add_liberty_desire = -10
			}
			remove_variable = oe_cel_dead_fief
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.9.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_dead_fief }
			var:oe_cel_dead_fief ?= {
				if = {
					limit = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_fanwang }
					change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal
					add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_cel_op_revoked }
				}
			}
			remove_variable = oe_cel_dead_fief
		}
		oe_cel_bump_revocation_tension = yes
	}
}

# 18. The debate on government, ten years after the Mandate (yearly pulse)
oe_cel.18 = {
	type = country_event

	desc = oe_cel.18.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel_mandate_court.dds"

		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_debate_done value = 1 }

	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.18.a

		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_debate_side value = 1 }

	}

		name = oe_cel.18.b
		ai_chance = { base = 50 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_debate_side value = 2 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_ideology_right_mod years = 30 mode = replace }

# 25. Yuan Touxia dual-path commutation / provincialization (fired by oe_cel_ci_touxia_provincialize)
oe_cel.25 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel.25.title
	desc = oe_cel.25.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel2_touxia_province.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.25.a
		ai_chance = { base = 80 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_touxia_prov_target }
			var:oe_cel_touxia_prov_target ?= {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_touxia_commuted_chao_mod mode = replace }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_touxia_commuted value = 1 }
			}
			remove_variable = oe_cel_touxia_prov_target
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_dev_ev25_unlock }
			remove_variable = oe_cel_dev_ev25_unlock
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_yuan_xingsheng_fiscal_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
		oe_cel_cool_revocation_tension = { amount = 1 }
		oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.25.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = oe_cel_dev_ev25_unlock
				AND = {
					current_year >= 1410
					gold >= 180
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_crisis_active }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_touxia_prov_target }
						var:oe_cel_touxia_prov_target ?= {
							is_subject_of = root
							is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia
							subject_loyalty >= 60
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NOT = { current_celestial_authority = { value = 80 } }
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				gold < 400
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { gold >= 180 }
			add_gold = -180
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel_touxia_provincialized_count } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel_touxia_provincialized_count value = 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_cel_touxia_provincialized_count add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_touxia_prov_target }
			var:oe_cel_touxia_prov_target ?= {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject_of = root
						is_subject_type = oe_yw_touxia
					}
					change_subject_type = subject_type:vassal
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_prince }
						remove_variable = oe_yw_prince
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_yw_out value = 5 }
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost }
						remove_variable = oe_yw_fy_lost
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_loyal
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_aloof
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_yw_tier_estranged
					}
					add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_touxia_transition_grant_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
				}
			}
			remove_variable = oe_cel_touxia_prov_target
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_cel_dev_ev25_unlock }
			remove_variable = oe_cel_dev_ev25_unlock
		}
		oe_cel_bump_revocation_tension = yes
		oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes
	}
}

# 26. Nanyang Palembang / Malacca hub milestone (yearly pulse, 1400+)
oe_cel.26 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel.26.title
	desc = oe_cel.26.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel2_nanyang_malacca.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_ev26_done value = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.26.a
		ai_chance = { base = 70 }
		add_prestige = 10
		change_celestial_authority = { value = celestial_authority_very_weak_bonus }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_nanyang_hub_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.26.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		add_gold = -60
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_nanyang_fleet_depot_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	}
}

# 27. Indian Ocean Treasure Fleet milestone at Calicut / Kotte (yearly pulse)
oe_cel.27 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel.27.title
	desc = oe_cel.27.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel_treasure_ocean.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel_ev27_done value = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.27.a
		ai_chance = { base = 75 }
		add_gold = -80
		add_prestige = 15
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel_indian_ocean_stele_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:ZMR
				NOT = { tag = ZMR }
			}
			c:ZMR = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:VIJ
				NOT = { tag = VIJ }
			}
			c:VIJ = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed } }
		}
		location:kotte = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = {
						NOT = { this = root }
						is_rebel_country = no
					}
				}
				owner = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed } }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.27.b
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
		add_prestige = 10
		change_celestial_authority = { value = celestial_authority_very_weak_bonus }
	}
}

# 90. Dev page 83 & 87 readout (Celestial 2.0)
oe_cel.90 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_cel.90.title
	desc = {
		desc = oe_cel.90.desc_header
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes }
				desc = oe_cel.90.desc_track
			}
			desc = oe_cel.90.desc_not_emperor
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_global_variable = oe_cel_track_override }
				desc = oe_cel.90.desc_override_on
			}
			desc = oe_cel.90.desc_override_off
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { oe_cel_ai_enabled = yes }
				desc = oe_cel.90.desc_ai_on
			}
			desc = oe_cel.90.desc_ai_off
		}
		desc = oe_cel.90.desc_counts
		desc = oe_cel.90.desc_cel2_counts
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { has_variable = oe_cel_crisis_active }
				desc = oe_cel.90.desc_crisis_on
			}
			desc = oe_cel.90.desc_crisis_off
		}
	}
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_cel_mandate_court.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.90.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cel.90.b
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel.90
	}
}
